TOM MCCALL
OFFICE OF THE GOVERNOR
STATE CAPITOL
SALEM 97310
April 28, 1972
Mr. Yates M. Barber, Jr.
Acting Chief, Office of
   Environmental Quality
U.S. Department of Interior
Bureau of Sport Fisheries & Wildlife
Fish and Wildlife Service
Washington, D.C. 20240
Re: Endangered Species Conservation  Draft EIS #DES 72-44
PNRS #7203 4 130
Dear Mr. Barber:
We have circulated your draft environmental impact statement to the proper state agencies for their review and comment.
The Oregon State Game Commission has issued several major statements on the Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972 and we have enclosed a copy for your consideration. We concur with the above statements and request that you take them into consideration when writing your final environmental impact statement.
If any other draft is prepared prior to the issuance of your final environmental impact statement, we would appreciate a courtesy copy.
Sincerely,
Kessler R. Cannon
Assistant to the Governor
Natural Resources
KRC: Km
Enclos
